sentences.text: NanoHalen Oy is a portfolio company registered on 2023-10-23 under the industry code 26510, manufacture of instruments and appliances for measuring, testing and navigation.
The register shows a start-up notification dated 2023-11-30, share issues dated 2024-06-13 and 2025-10-10, and first sales on 2024-05-01.
Funding on record is a round dated 2024 with the year only and a Business Finland decision of EUR 60 000 for 2025.
On the radar's rules technology and business readiness are level 4 and investment readiness is level 3.
The registered industry is instrument manufacturing and no ocean category is found, so ocean impact is unknown and the memo keeps it on the watchlist.
